sources.application_limits: Tighter tolerances require explicit drawing/tool-list request; no published ±.05+.05 acceptance for X1. Latest tolerance table also checked.

Profile/cutout registration is specifically to holes. ±.05 nonplated round-hole size does not establish contour accuracy. Outer.25 criterion matches proposed two-layer board; no manufacturing acceptance implied.

sources.locator: Rigid PCB / PCB Specifications / Dimension Tolerance; Drilling / Slots; Outline / Routed
sources.application_limits: Outline dimensional tolerance is not cutout-to-copper registration. Precision requires tooling holes on different corners. No separate contour positional bound stated; hole position is not substituted. X1-control36×32 fails bare-board precision size condition; panel applicability not established.

sources.application_limits: The raw HTML row/header alignment was inspected: below±.10 shape tolerance is in Unable to make, not Non-standard review. Independent hole-position capability is not contour-position acceptance. This page is general process capability, not an X1 quote.

conclusion: No inspected publication establishes the requested separate ±.05 dimensional/±.05 positional contour controls for these cutouts. General capabilities cannot be promoted to actual construction acceptance. Alternative avoids the close cutouts rather than assuming their precision.
